requirement.value: Cook, Rogue or Engineer mastery (the Merchant route is cut)

system.description: Inventory action: throw a material or rare item you own at a visible creature for (its value ÷ 50) damage, typed by the item's nature (else physical). Then d6: 1 destroys it, 2–3 damages it (destroyed if thrown again; unusable until repaired), 4–6 no harm.
